title: Woods Building Services v Milton Keynes Council
description: The contracting authority's decision to award a £8 million asbestos removal and reinstatement services contract was challenged by Woods Building Services, the incumbent provider. The challenger alleged manifest error in the scoring of individual quality criteria and breach of transparency and equal treatment obligations. The court found that the tender evaluation process was fundamentally flawed across multiple scoring items, requiring a reduction of 40 marks for EAS's bid and an increase of 6 marks for Woods' bid. Applying the published 60% price / 40% quality formula, the court concluded that Woods' bid became the most economically advantageous tender.
